partial_inventory.scope: Missing mandatory Direct rejects without target status or lease mutation; missing Scanlines falls back to exact linked Direct on the same host. No corrupt-part or Scanlines-only physical acceptance.
partial_inventory.unresolved: Original unscoped Health503 and cleanup Stop500 cause remains unresolved; paired diagnostic read scoping is not a production fix.

publication_note: Historical receipts keep exact original source paths and revisions. Failed 3ffe image history and failed 6ed partial-observation attempts remain separate from passing 6ed captures and the paired-observation partial result. platform/baseline-verified-original.json is the saved pre-update baseline; platform/restored-baseline.json records final restoration. Included ROMs are generated MIT diagnostics, not captured AV. All payloads are byte-exact copies; typed source summaries remain explicitly classified by their original authors.
